blockingFindings.description: V81 restores 40 mm forward projection on the front/lap panels. The current pose coverage diagnostic improves sit overskirt coverage only from 18.3/20.1% to 19.5/19.8% on the thighs and crouch from 33.3/32.9% to 33.7/32.9%; direct sit/crouch renders still show broad anterior-thigh exposure and a pointed side tab. Astra independently confirmed the coverage failure.
left.png and back.png retain pronounced accordion ridges that dominate the side/back drape. The front projection trial does not change side-panel fold quality.
front.png and three-quarter.png still show an uneven hem dipping at the center. Astra independently requested revising pose-responsive front coverage and smoothing side drape, then reviewing the hem.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
